_about: Wire format of POST /api/tool/execute (request {operationId, tool, stateVersion, params, deadlineUtc?}). JSON is camelCase with null fields omitted; source: Models/ExecutionResponse.cs and the Run envelope in Services/SolidWorksService.Envelope.cs. Every CAD outcome is HTTP 200; HTTP 400 only for a malformed request or an unknown tool.

COMPLETED.stateVersion: integer: +1 after a mutating tool, unchanged after a read-only one
COMPLETED.result_geometry: optional: the tool's payload (object or array), e.g. the body summary after a feature or a millimetre tool's JSON result

FAILED.stateVersion: integer: the current version; +1 when a mutating tool changed the model before it failed (the message then says so and the adapter resyncs)

error.code: string, one vocabulary (header of SolidWorksService.Envelope.cs): MISSING_PARAMETER, BAD_PARAMETER, NO_ACTIVE_DOCUMENT, NOT_A_PART / NOT_AN_ASSEMBLY / NOT_A_DRAWING / NOT_SHEET_METAL, WRONG_DOCUMENT_TYPE, <THING>_NOT_FOUND, <ACTION>_FAILED, FEATURE_ERROR, INVALID_STATE_VERSION, COM_ERROR, UNEXPECTED_ERROR
error.message: string written for the model: what was wrong and what to do

DUPLICATE.last_known_state_version: integer: a replayed operationId of a mutating call is answered, not executed again
